cleanup.intro: This does the following and cannot be undone:
cleanup.step1: Stops all instances and removes leftover containers and networks
cleanup.step2: Deletes every non-admin user in CTFd and their records
cleanup.step4: Removes the unused images and registry tags listed below, clears the build cache and anonymous volumes, and compacts the registry (it restarts briefly)
cleanup.summary: {images} images will be removed (up to {size} freed; this adds up image sizes, so shared layers are counted more than once) along with {tags} registry tags. The list is computed again after instances are stopped.
cleanup.done: Done: stopped {instances} instances, removed {containers} containers and {networks} networks, deleted {users} users, cleared {sessions} sessions, removed {images} images and {tags} registry tags (up to {size}). Returning to the login page.
